newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield seeking U.S. airport deals.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield seeking U.S. airport deals.

text.p: Westfield Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was seeking further contracts in the U.S. to develop, lease and manage airport retail space.
Westfield already operates the Dulles International Airport and National Airport in Washington DC, and was last year awarded the contract for retail space at Boston Logan International Airport.
"We are actively pursuing other contracts in the United States," Lowy told reporters after the release of the company's half year results.
"It's an area where we can use our expertise to add value for an airport owner," he said.
Lowy said the Logan contract was in its early stages and would come onstream over the next couple of years.
He said the retail was not large at 40,000 square feet, but added that airport retail centres could not be compared with shopping centres due to the different mix of retailers.
